chapter: Porgy and Bess and Varsity Show
title: Big name on Broadway but not yet making money
summary: He says his head did not swell; he still wanted a category where he could make money, such as pictures.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: So now your name is very big on Broadway in particular.
And your relationship with Nazarro I would imagine is still on the cautious side.
I'm sure he was feeling very good, though, because he was making a lot of money off you.
How were you feeling at this point as a performer? Was your head beginning to swell?
No, I ain't got nowhere yet. I ain't where I want to be yet.
Where do you want to be?

I want to be -- in a category where I can make some money, man. I ain't making no money, no. I got to make some money and the only way I can make some money is like getting in pictures or something like that, I figure. So we leave the Ziegfeld Follies and we go over to England --
